title: D2 in-process slot-key spec
description: Single source of truth for cross-binding in-process slot keys (e.g. HttpContext.Items + ServerCallContext.UserState). Codegen emits binding-specific catalogs on the .NET side; no TS analog (ASP.NET / gRPC only).

value.description: Wire value of the slot key. Identical across every binding listed in `bindings`.

purpose.description: Human-readable description of the slot's purpose. Emitted as xmldoc on every catalog the key appears in.

bindings.description: Closed enum of in-process bindings the key applies to.
